name: Flowsery - web analytics and session insights
description:
Flowsery is cookie-free web analytics. It tracks traffic, goals and revenue for your websites, and its AI reviews session recordings to build a ranked list of issues: bugs, broken flows and UX problems, each with how many sessions hit it and steps to replicate.

From Claude you can: list the websites in your workspace; get an overview of visitors, pageviews, bounce rate and revenue for any date range, or as a timeseries; break traffic down by page, referrer, channel, campaign, country, region, city, device, browser, operating system or hostname, or combine dimensions in a custom breakdown; see who is on the site right now and where they are; follow a single visitor's journey step by step; pull the top AI-detected issues, open one with its occurrences and affected sessions, and mark it resolved once fixed; and record or delete goal events and payments so revenue is tied back to the channel that brought it. Twenty-seven tools in total.

Sign in with your Flowsery account. You need at least one website with the Flowsery tracking script installed.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Flowsery - web analytics and session insights to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Flowsery - web analytics and session insights to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.flowsery.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Flowsery - web analytics and session insights MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flowsery - web analytics and session insights lists 27 MCP tools, including delete_goals, delete_payments, get_breakdown, get_browsers, get_campaigns, get_channels, get_cities, get_countries, get_devices, get_goals, get_hostnames, and get_issue.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Flowsery - web analytics and session insights?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Flowsery - web analytics and session insights in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Flowsery - web analytics and session insights MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flowsery - web analytics and session insights requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Flowsery - web analytics and session insights?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flowsery - web analytics and session insights is developed by Flowsery. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
